analysis.title: Situation Room: Out of bonds and loans, into stocks
key_insights: US high grade bond funds and ETFs had a -$0.13bn outflow in the week ending Nov 18, the biggest outflow since April 2026, down from a +$1.92bn inflow the prior week. IG corporates are about a third of high grade fund AUM, so IG demand was roughly flat.
HG ETF inflows slowed to +$3.92bn from +$6.35bn. HG Funds outflows eased to -$4.05bn from -$4.43bn.
Short-term HG inflows slowed to +$0.33bn from +$0.96bn. HG ex short-term flows turned to -$0.46bn from +$0.96bn, the biggest outflow since March 2026.
Equity fund inflows were +$46.42bn in the week ending Nov 18, down from +$51.63bn the prior week.
HY flows turned to -$2.29bn from +$0.61bn, the biggest outflow since March 2026. HY ETFs saw -$1.95bn and HY funds -$0.35bn.
Loan fund flows turned to -$0.25bn from +$0.11bn. Munis slowed to +$0.26bn from +$0.41bn.
Global EM bond outflows accelerated to -$1.40bn from -$1.00bn, the biggest outflow since April 2026.
Money markets took in +$1.48bn after an -$18.39bn outflow the week before.
Year-to-date flows as a share of AUM: loans 10.1% (the largest), munis 8.5%, high grade 8.0% ($407.8bn), equities 1.8% ($526.1bn), HY 1.2% ($5.7bn), EM 1.7%. All fixed income is 8.3% ($692.9bn).

US IG issuance was $15.2bn across 6 deals on Nov 19 (excluding Saturn Funding), $46.5bn week to date and $163.8bn month to date. The average new issue concession was 4.5bps, and this week's new issues trade 3bps tighter on average from pricing.

Estimated IG dealer inventories of US issuer bonds rose to $6.1bn on Nov 19 from $1.2bn on Nov 11. Estimated inventory DV01 rose to -$2.4mn from -$5.9mn. Dealers added an estimated $2,473mn on Nov 19, $5,805mn over one week and $28,029mn over four weeks.
By sector, dealers added $1,112mn of Banks/Brokers bonds on Nov 19 and $5,443mn over four weeks. Energy fell $169mn on the day but rose $4,505mn over four weeks.
Daily HG fund flow on Nov 18 was -$1,455mn versus +$783mn on Nov 17. Average daily HG inflow was -$345mn in November versus +$708mn in October.
HG fund flows tend to follow returns since Oct 2023, though they have been decoupled from returns since about Oct 2024.

Foreign demand proxies for USD IG: net dealer volume before 8am ET was -$165mn for 1-10yr and -$107mn for 10yr+ on Nov 19. Dealer-to-affiliate volume from 8am to noon was -$166mn for 1-10yr and +$15mn for 10yr+. The 12-day moving average of foreign buying rose $8mn over five business days while the 30-year Treasury yield was unchanged.
risk_factors: HG ex short-term, HY and EM bond flows posted their largest outflows since March or April 2026.
HG fund flows have decoupled from returns since about Oct 2024.
charts_described: Exhibit 21 plots daily HG fund/ETF flow (10d MA) against the 2M price return on the US IG corporate index. The text says flows tend to follow returns since Oct 2023 but have been decoupled since around Oct 2024.

Exhibit 26 plots net dealer buy from foreign investors in 10yr+ bonds (12d MA) against the 12-day change in 30-year Treasury yields. The text says a drop in yield typically leads to lower foreign demand.
vol_and_positioning: Fund flow positioning: equity inflows of +$46.42bn against outflows from HG, HY, loans and EM bonds in the week ending Nov 18.
Estimated IG dealer inventories rose to $6.1bn on Nov 19 from $1.2bn on Nov 11, so dealers hold more bonds.
